entries.title: Job 4:1
segments: ¶Then Eliphaz the Temanite answered and said,

entries.title: Job 4:2
segments: [If] we assay to commune with thee, wilt thou be grieved? but who can withhold himself from speaking? {to...: Heb. a word} {withhold...: Heb. refrain from words?}

words.text: with thee, wilt thou be grieved
? {to...: Heb. a word} {withhold...: Heb. refrain from words?}

entries.title: Job 4:3
segments: Behold, thou hast instructed many, and thou hast strengthened the weak hands.

entries.title: Job 4:4
segments: Thy words have upholden him that was falling, and thou hast strengthened the feeble knees.

entries.title: Job 4:5
segments: But now it is come upon thee, and thou faintest; it toucheth thee, and thou art troubled.

entries.title: Job 4:6
segments: [Is] not [this] thy fear, thy confidence, thy hope, and the uprightness of thy ways?

entries.title: Job 4:7
segments: ¶Remember, I pray thee, who [ever] perished, being innocent? or where were the righteous cut off?

entries.title: Job 4:8
segments: Even as I have seen, they that plow iniquity, and sow wickedness, reap the same.

entries.title: Job 4:9
segments: By the blast of God they perish, and by the breath of his nostrils are they consumed. {by the breath...: that is, by his anger}

words.text: . {by the breath...: that is, by his anger}

entries.title: Job 4:10
segments: The roaring of the lion, and the voice of the fierce lion, and the teeth of the young lions, are broken.

entries.title: Job 4:11
segments: The old lion perisheth for lack of prey, and the stout lion's whelps are scattered abroad.

entries.title: Job 4:12
segments: ¶Now a thing was secretly brought to me, and mine ear received a little thereof. {secretly: Heb. by stealth}

entries.title: Job 4:13
segments: In thoughts from the visions of the night, when deep sleep falleth on men,

entries.title: Job 4:14
segments: Fear came upon me, and trembling, which made all my bones to shake. {came...: Heb. met} {all: Heb. the multitude of}

words.text: . {came...: Heb. met} {all: Heb. the multitude of}

entries.title: Job 4:15
segments: Then a spirit passed before my face; the hair of my flesh stood up:

entries.title: Job 4:16
segments: It stood still, but I could not discern the form thereof: an image [was] before mine eyes, [there was] silence, and I heard a voice, [saying], {there...: or, I heard a still voice}

words.text: , [saying], {there...: or, I heard a still voice}

entries.title: Job 4:17
segments: Shall mortal man be more just than God? shall a man be more pure than his maker?

entries.title: Job 4:18
segments: Behold, he put no trust in his servants; and his angels he charged with folly: {and his...: or, nor in his angels, in whom he put light}

words.text: : {and his...: or, nor in his angels, in whom he put light}

entries.title: Job 4:19
segments: How much less [in] them that dwell in houses of clay, whose foundation [is] in the dust, [which] are crushed before the moth?

entries.title: Job 4:20
segments: They are destroyed from morning to evening: they perish for ever without any regarding [it]. {destroyed: Heb. beaten in pieces}

entries.title: Job 4:21
segments: Doth not their excellency [which is] in them go away? they die, even without wisdom.
